dice.name: Avoid Dice
dice.hint: This causes dice to avoid other dice so they don't overlap (within the same roll) for their final location (may have performance costs)

windows.name: Avoid Windows
windows.hint: This causes dice to avoid windows for their final location (may have performance costs)

enabled.name: Add Dice Borders
enabled.hint: Adds Dice borders to the render at a bit of performance cost

user-color.name: Dice Border - Use Player Color
user-color.hint: Uses player color to affect dice borders

delay-between.name: Delay Between Dice
delay-between.hint: How long should there be in delay between each dice rolled for a message in seconds

display-duration.name: Display Duration
display-duration.hint: How long should the result be show in seconds

show-above-ui.name: Show Above UI
show-above-ui.hint: Show this modules dice and numbers above the UI

show-ghost-rolls.name: Show 'Ghost' Rolls
show-ghost-rolls.hint: Show dice rolling for rolls that the user can't see but don't show them the result

override.name: Override Default Message SFX for Rolls
override.hint: Overrides the default message sfx for rolls with a relevant randomly selected one from the list of roll sfxs relevant for the amount of dice rolled

theme.name: Override SFX Theme
theme.hint: Choose the theme of the sound effects (IE what soundpack) to be improved a later time

size.name: Dice Size
size.hint: Set the size of the dice (1 = 100%)

roll-duration.name: Roll Duration
roll-duration.hint: How long should the dice roll for in seconds
